svg.title: When each frequently failing test failed, 9 July to 8 October 2026
svg.text: Flakes come and go: 91 days of two Kubernetes CI jobs
One tick per failed build. Every test that failed five times or more, and the newcomers that failed three times.
first failed in the last 30 days
a pull request naming the test merged soon after (Kubernetes' tracker)
Builds from the public Prow bucket; tests named in each failed package's own output. Quiet and new are flakemap's calls from where the ticks fall.
